# One real certificate chain, frozen: what www.amazon.com served on
# 2026-08-02, plus the Amazon Root CA 1 as the host's own trust store
# holds it -- the root is taken from /etc/ssl/cert.pem rather than from
# what the peer sent, since trusting the chain's own last certificate
# would be circular.
#
# This exists because a private test PKI is generated by one tool with
# one set of defaults, and real CA certificates are not: they carry
# authority key identifiers, CRL distribution points, certificate
# policies, OCSP URLs and name forms that nothing in tests/golden's
# generated PKI produces. Parsing those is the case that matters.
#
# Its validity window has an end, so the test that uses it names an
# instant rather than asking what time it is.
#
# name <DER as hex>
amazon_root 
amazon_0 
amazon_1
